english.title: Finder of a stray dog fail to return it to owner / take it to Local Authority
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the finder of a stray dog failed to comply with the requirements of section 150(1) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 to forthwith return the dog to its owner or take the dog to the officer of the local authority for the area in which the dog was found and inform the officer of the local authority where the dog was found
english.legislation: Contrary to section 150(1) and (5) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990.
